```{r}
sps_list = c("Adig", "Ahya", "Amur", "Fspp", "Gfas", "Hcoe", "Pcru", "Pdam", "Plut", "Spin", "Xesp")
oga <- read.table(
    "/absolute/path/orthology_inputs/Anthozoa_all_genome_260426/orthogroup_conservation.csv",
    sep = "\t",
    header = TRUE,
    quote = "",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
ogm <- read.table(
    "/absolute/path/orthology_inputs/Metazoa_all_genome_260426/orthogroup_conservation_integrated.csv",
    sep = "\t",
    header = TRUE,
    quote = "",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
ogm_gv <- dic_from_vecs(names = ogm$gene, terms = ogm$orthogroup_name)
ogm_tv <- dic_from_vecs(names = ogm$transcript, terms = ogm$orthogroup_name)
```

```{r}
for (spi in sps_list) {

    # set working species
    if (spi == "Spin") {
        spi_w = "Spis"
	} else if (spi == "HcoeH" || spi == "HcoeI") {
        spi_w = "Hcoe"
    } else {
		spi_w = spi
	}
    # Load spi gene list (从 GTF 或者表达矩阵获取)
    message(sprintf("  - Loading %s gene list from GTF...", spi))
    suppressMessages(require("rtracklayer"))
    
    gtf_fn = sprintf("/absolute/path/orthology_inputs/reference_gtf_Metazoa/%s_long.annot.gtf",spi_w)
    gene_txgtf = rtracklayer::import(gtf_fn)
    
    # 提取所有 gene_id
    spi_gtf_genes = unique(gene_txgtf$gene_id)
    # 移除可能的 NA 值
    spi_gtf_genes = spi_gtf_genes[!is.na(spi_gtf_genes)]
    spi_gtf_genes = fix_gene_name(spi_gtf_genes, paste0(spi_w, "_"))
    # transcript to gene
    transcript_to_gene <- dic_from_vecs(gene_txgtf$transcript_id, gene_txgtf$gene_id)
    if(spi %in% c("Ahya", "Plut")){
        transcript_to_gene <- dic_from_vecs(paste0(spi_w, "_", gene_txgtf$transcript_id), gene_txgtf$gene_id)
    }
    message(sprintf("    Loaded %d unique gene IDs from GTF", length(spi_gtf_genes)))

    if(spi_w != "Spis"){
        message(sprintf("  - Loading %s-Spis orthology...",spi))
        og_pairs_spi_spis = clean_og_pairs(
            og_pairs_fn = "/absolute/path/orthology_inputs/Anthozoa_all_genome_260426/orthogroup_pairs.genes.csv", 
            sp1 = spi_w, 
            sp2 = "Spis", 
            t2g = FALSE,
            header = TRUE
        )
        spi_to_spis = dic_from_vecs(og_pairs_spi_spis$sp1, og_pairs_spi_spis$sp2)
        message(sprintf("    Found %d spi-Spis ortholog pairs", nrow(og_pairs_spi_spis)))
    }else{
        spi_to_spis = dic_from_vecs(spi_gtf_genes, spi_gtf_genes)
    }
    # Create gene annotation dataframe
    gene_annot = data.frame(
        gene = spi_gtf_genes,
        spis_ortholog = spi_to_spis[spi_gtf_genes],
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    gna_i = ogm [ ogm$species == spi_w, ]
    gna_i = gna_i%>%
        select(gene, orthogroup_name)
    gene_annot = merge(gene_annot, gna_i, by.x = "gene", by.y = "gene", all.x = TRUE, all.y = FALSE)

    #Load Spis NCBI gene names
    message("  - Loading Spis NCBI gene names...")
    gnspis = read.table("/absolute/path/annotation_inputs/Spis_Genes_ncbi_dataset.tsv", header = TRUE, sep = "\t")
    gnspis = gnspis[!is.na(gnspis$Protein.accession) & gnspis$Protein.accession != "", ]
    gnspis$Name = gsub(" ", "_", gnspis$Name)
    gnspis_v = dic_from_vecs(gnspis$Protein.accession, gnspis$Name)
    message(sprintf("    Loaded %d Spis NCBI gene names", length(gnspis_v)))
    # Add Spis NCBI gene name
    gene_annot$spis_gene_name = gnspis_v[gene_annot$spis_ortholog]
    # 移除重复
    gene_annot = gene_annot[!duplicated(gene_annot$gene), ]
    rownames(gene_annot) = gene_annot$gene

    # Load Uniprot annotation
    message("  - Loading Uniprot annotation...")
    uniprot_fn = sprintf("../../reference_results/uniprot/%s_top_6species_longest.tsv", spi_w)
    Uniprot_match <- read.table(uniprot_fn, sep = "\t")
    Uniprot_match$V1 <- gsub("\\.p\\d+$", "", Uniprot_match$V1)
    Uniprot_match$V1 <- transcript_to_gene[Uniprot_match$V1]
    Uniprot_match$gene <- fix_gene_name(Uniprot_match$V1, paste0(spi_w, "_"))
    gene_to_Unip<- dic_from_vecs(Uniprot_match$gene, Uniprot_match$V2)
    gene_annot$Uniprot_name<- gene_to_Unip[gene_annot$gene]
    
    # 添加 is_tf 列
    gene_is_tf = dic_from_vecs(gene_annot$gene, grepl(":",gene_annot$orthogroup_name))
    gene_annot$is_tf = gene_is_tf[gene_annot$gene]

    # 统计注释覆盖度
    message(sprintf("  - Annotation coverage for spi:"))
    message(sprintf("    Total genes: %d", nrow(gene_annot)))
    message(sprintf("    Has Spis ortholog: %d (%.1f%%)", 
                    sum(!is.na(gene_annot$spis_ortholog)),
                    100 * sum(!is.na(gene_annot$spis_ortholog)) / nrow(gene_annot)))

    # 保存 spi 注释表
    write.table(
        gene_annot,
        sprintf("annot.%s.genes.csv", spi),
        sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE
    )
    }
```
